subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should active model-call stuck recovery use idle-timeout retry/fallback semantics while active side-effecting tool recovery remains non-replayable?
rationale: The code matches the requested shape, but deciding the permanent replay boundary for diagnostic recovery is an agent/session behavior decision that automation should not make alone.

options.title: Accept phase-aware boundary
options.body: Land after owner review with the current model-call versus side-effecting-tool distinction as the supported recovery behavior.

options.title: Require broader proof
options.body: Keep this PR open until additional runtime proof covers more model-call, tool-call, stale recovery, and reply-run fallback paths against latest main.

options.title: Pause for recovery timing
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98580 settles if maintainers want timing policy to land first.

recommendation.title: Accept phase-aware boundary
recommendation.body: Land after owner review with the current model-call versus side-effecting-tool distinction as the supported recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and already stated the replay-safety requirement this PR is trying to satisfy.
